info.description:
Update -May 03, 2024

Changelog : No schema level changes, updated samples only.
            US RTP fields and description added and updated the sample examples.
            IN fields and description added and updated the sample examples.
            UK fields and description added and updated the sample examples.
            Added instruction id and travel rule fields for Payment Initiation,Inquiry and Refunds.Added unstructured remittance info in the Refunds.
            Merged the swagger for Payments and Non Payments
            BR refund description added and updated the sample examples
            Relaxed travel rules. Made Debtor,Creditor,Ultimate Debtor and Ultimate creditor address fields optional
            Added new non pay messages- Request for payment, Response to request for payment,Outgoing request for refund, Response to request for refund
            End to End ID field updated as mandatory for both payment and refund initiation.
            JP fields and description added and updated the sample examples.
            IN UPI fields and description added and updated the sample examples.
            Added network_id field for refund response, applicable for Brazil country.

API services for Express payment and non payment initiation and status
- The message structure (schema) for both incoming and outgoing payments statuses is the same. This applies to both pull (ie GET command) and push (ie push notifications)
- Non Payment and Payment Confirmation status schema is common across status notification & inquiry response.

API services for validating the beneficiary account details registered in Citi or externally in a scheme or a third party bank. This is a two step process:
1. Call the POST (Beneficiary Validation) API using the creditor and debtor details
2. In the push notification or status inqury (using GET API), creditor resolved name will be obtained

parameters.name: encrypted-params
parameters.description:
Encrypt the key values as below. Debtor account or creditor account is mandatory.


* **debtor_account:** Your Citi account for instant payment (debit) / outgoing

* **creditor_account:** Your Citi account for instant payment (credit) / incoming

* **debtor_proxy_id:** Debtor proxy identification - For US RTP Instant Payment - debtor_proxy_id header param is not applicable

* **creditor_proxy_id:** Creditor proxy identification - For US RTP Instant Payment - creditor_proxy_id header param is not applicable

* **debtor_virtual_account:** Your Citi virtual account for instant payment (debit) / outgoing - For US RTP Instant Payment - debtor_virtual_account header param is not applicable

* **creditor_virtual_account:** Your Citi virtual account for instant payment (credit) / incoming - For US RTP Instant Payment - creditor_virtual_account header param is not applicable

***Sample header before encryption:*** {"debtor_account":"3001386964","creditor_proxy_id":"a93d@gmail.com"}
